name.description: Kebab-case name of the dialog component and its directory. Defaults to the dasherized node id.

path.description: Directory that receives the dialog directory, within the selected application source root. Defaults to the application's app directory.

project.description: Angular application project. Required when the workspace has multiple application source roots.

document.description: Workspace-relative path to a canonical OpenUI JSON document (*.openui.json or *.json). Compiles a dialog node into a Material dialog component: uses.open, uses.modal, produces.close and produces.cancel come from the node, and the children of its header, section and footer regions are compiled and embedded into the title, content and actions sections.

nodeId.description: Optional element ID within the OpenUI document to compile. When omitted, targets the first dialog element.
